message: Live Windows 2.2.13 evidence: turn 43 is still stuck target=GPT. After start at 20:30:11 the control page is repeatedly selected as page=equivalent, but every poll is diag=zero_messages, messages=0, composer=0, unavailable=0 (checks 97,98,99,100). Therefore the rendered hard-error detector is not firing on this broken control page, so rebind never starts. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.14 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) Keep the existing explicit RU/EN hard-unavailable detector, but add a second bounded evidence path for an equivalent/same saved control conversation that is persistently blank: same/equivalent control URL, messages=0, composer=0, generation inactive, and not explicitly signed-out. Do NOT treat a single zero_messages observation as unavailable. (2) Track this blank state with a separate persistent latch/counter tied to the exact saved control URL, e.g. blank_for_url + blank_checks/blank_since; increment only on consecutive matching observations, reset on any messages, composer readiness, generation activity, URL change, ready marker, or successful rebind. After a conservative threshold (for example 3 consecutive polls / >=30s), classify as unavailable_for_rebind and allow the existing one-time rebind path. Do not reuse the historical unready_checks directly because it survives restarts and is already 100. (3) Preserve the one-rebind-only semantics from 2.2.13: at most one fresh service page/chat for that old URL, bootstrap once, no unrelated navigation, fail closed if signed out/no composer/no new URL, no tab growth, preserve recovery/bootstrap/GitHub state. (4) Add tests proving: one or two blank polls do not rebind; threshold consecutive blank equivalent polls do rebind; counter is URL-scoped and resets on composer/messages/url change; historical unready_checks alone cannot trigger; explicit rendered unavailable still triggers immediately; failed/successful rebind de-dup remains unchanged. (5) Preserve 2.2.10 raw->api failover, CHECK_INTERVAL=5, text-free logs, main and arena/local-agent-v0 unchanged, no Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=45 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests and blank-evidence semantics.
